about: Items: kinds of thing a creature can carry. Orsino weapons and armour are generated into data/catalog/orsino/items.json; this file holds Kyr's own items and adaptations. weapon gives the damage die and type for the attack roll; armor gives the armour class it subtracts; modifiers and hooks act while the item is equipped; grants give a skill or an ability.

rope.name: Coil of rope
rope.description: A length of sturdy rope for climbing, tying, or securing items.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: A sturdy crowbar for prying open doors or crates.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

pole.name: Ten-foot pole
pole.description: A long ash pole, iron-shod at one end. For testing floors, prodding what should not be touched, and reaching what should not be reached for.

source.notes: Orsino's pole, given the length and the uses Kyr's tries ask of it.

sandbag.name: Sack of sand
sandbag.description: A tied sack of dry sand, about as heavy as a small child. Useless, until it is not.

thieves_tools.name: Thieves' tools
thieves_tools.description: A set of tools for picking locks and disarming traps.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

shovel.name: Shovel
shovel.description: A sturdy shovel for digging or moving earth.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

bell.name: Bell
bell.description: A small bell that can be used to signal others or scare off wildlife.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

map.name: Map of the district
map.description: A hand-drawn map of the local roads and landmarks.

source.notes: Starting gear of the explorer; absent from Orsino's gear catalog.

bandages.name: Bandages
bandages.description: Clean linen for binding wounds. One use.

source.notes: Starting gear of the medic; absent from Orsino's gear catalog.

herbs.name: Healing herbs
herbs.description: A twist of dried herbs for a poultice. One use.

source.notes: Starting gear of the medic; absent from Orsino's gear catalog.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: A single dose removes the poisoned condition from a living companion.

source.notes: Orsino removes the status named Poison; Kyr removes poisoned.

healingdraught.name: Minor healing potion
healingdraught.description: A single dose restores 2d4 + 2 health to a living companion.

fireproof_salve.name: Fireproof salve
fireproof_salve.description: A clay pot of ash-and-lanolin salve. Smeared on skin and clothing, it makes fire do half its harm for a while.
fireproof_salve.use: Apply fireproof to ally for 10 turns.

source.notes: A Kyr preparation of Orsino's fireproof; lasts ten of the wearer's combat turns.

yarrow_poultice.name: Prepared yarrow poultice
yarrow_poultice.description: Crushed yarrow bound in a cloth. It stops bleeding and eases a small wound.
yarrow_poultice.use: Remove bleeding from ally. Heal (1d3) health to ally.

longsword_of_flames.name: Longsword of Flames
longsword_of_flames.description: A longsword engulfed in magical flames, dealing extra fire damage on hit.

source.notes: Orsino gives it no weapon kind or weight, so every weapon proficiency that names kinds excludes it; warriors (all weapons) can wield it.

warding_focus.name: Foundry ward focus
warding_focus.description: A copper warding focus. A companion who knows how can raise a ward against fire with it.

source.notes: Kyr implement that grants the fire ward technique.

ashwood_charm.name: Ashwood ward charm
ashwood_charm.description: A mortuary charm of ashwood and bronze wire, left on an offering tray. Whoever wears it turns aside harm and resists what would overcome them.

wardens_blade.name: Warden's blade
wardens_blade.description: A balanced mortuary blade carried by the wardens of the dead. It strikes harder than its weight suggests.

lantern_of_names.name: Lantern of names
lantern_of_names.description: A hooded lantern whose consecrated flame shows the names and markings the keepers wrote in light.

climbing_harness.name: Climber's harness
climbing_harness.description: A rope, pitons and a fitted harness.

bronze_bearing.name: Bronze bearing
bronze_bearing.description: A heavy bronze bearing from old foundry machinery: valuable to a salvager, sacred to nobody.

burial_register.name: Burial register
burial_register.description: A waxed register of the named dead, in a keeper's careful hand.

grave_rings.name: Grave rings
grave_rings.description: Rings, brooches and coffin buckles taken from the dead, threaded on a grave-cord.

chapel_plate.name: Chapel plate
chapel_plate.description: A garrison chapel's silver: a censer, a paten and a cup, black with tarnish.

jade_idol.name: Jade idol
jade_idol.description: A squat idol of green jade with a hollow belly and an expression of polite disappointment.

cell_key.name: Iron cell key
cell_key.description: A heavy iron key on a loop of grave-cord.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.description: A hooded lantern of tin and horn. Filled with lamp oil and lit, it gives a steady light for six hours, and keeps it out of the wind.

source.notes: Orsino's lantern lasts 24 where a torch lasts 4. A Kyr torch burns an hour, so a lantern burns six on a flask of oil, and is lit again with another.

lamp.name: Lamp
lamp.description: An oil lamp of clay with a wick in its spout. Filled with lamp oil and lit, it gives a small steady light.

source.notes: Orsino's lamp lasts 12 where a torch lasts 4. Here it burns a flask of lamp oil, as the lantern does, rather than lighting the dark for ever.

lamp_oil.name: Flask of lamp oil
lamp_oil.description: A stoppered flask of lamp oil: enough to keep a lantern burning six hours.
lamp_oil.use: Apply lamplit to self for 6 hours.

source.notes: What a lantern burns (Orsino's lantern has a duration and no fuel; here the duration is in the flask).

candle.name: Candle
candle.description: A tallow candle. Lit, it burns about two hours: a small light, easily put out.
candle.use: Apply candlelit to self for 2 hours.

source.notes: Orsino's candle lasts 6 where a torch lasts 4: a Kyr hour and a half, burned in whole hours.

torch.name: Torch
torch.description: A pitch-soaked torch. Lit, it burns for about an hour and lights the dark; it also sets dry things burning.

source.notes: Orsino's torch is a light source with a duration. Kyr gives it meaning through world rules: changes that need fire.

torch.use: Apply torchlit to self for 1 hour.

noonlight.name: Jar of noonlight
noonlight.description: A stoppered jar of thick old glass, full of the light of a summer noon. It does not flicker, and things that hate the day hate it.

moonlight.name: Jar of moonlight
moonlight.description: A jar of cold, steady silver light. It shows shapes, not colours, and never goes out.

first_light.name: The First Light
first_light.description: The Lamplighters' mother-jar, as big as a child, warm to the touch: the first noon they ever bottled, kept to light the beacon.

toll_silver.name: Toll silver
toll_silver.description: A sack of mixed coin and hack-silver: a season of the Toll.

gilt_crown.name: Gilded crown
gilt_crown.description: A heavy crown worked with lamps and gilded thick. It is heavier than gold should be.

gilt_sceptre.name: Gilded sceptre
gilt_sceptre.description: A sceptre topped with a gilded lamp, heavy in the hand.

sun_disc.name: Sun-disc
sun_disc.description: A disc of beaten gold as wide as a shield, worked with rays, that catches any light and throws it back.

lamplighter_seal.name: Lamplighters' seal
lamplighter_seal.description: A brass seal on a chain, a lamp with a hand closed round it: the Charter's mark, which the old doors of the Lamplighters still answer to.

exchange_ledger.name: The Exchange's black ledger
exchange_ledger.description: A slim ledger bound in black calf, in a clerk's hand: sums paid out of the Salt Exchange's strongroom to 'O.N., at the Gap', every month since the spring.

hollow_regalia.name: The Lamplighters' regalia
hollow_regalia.description: A chain of office in white gold, each link a little lamp, taken from the last Warden of Lampfall by the thing that keeps his hall.

bell_teeth.name: Bell-teeth
bell_teeth.description: Teeth of old bronze, each the size of a fist and shaped like a small bell, prised out of a wheel of grey stone. Worth good money to a barge-master.

sluice_rod.name: Notched rod
sluice_rod.description: A staff of black wood shod at both ends in bronze, the bronze notched along its edge in a close, careful pattern.

tin_lantern.name: Tin lantern
tin_lantern.description: A miner's lantern of tin with a horn window. This one's window is packed with clay, and it will not light.

keeper_mask.name: Grey mask
keeper_mask.description: A smooth face of grey fired clay, without eyes or mouth, with a single notch where a brow would be. It rings when it is struck.

old_glossary.name: Glossary of the old script
old_glossary.description: A fat book in wooden boards, in which brothers of a dead order wrote the old script's letters beside their own, and copied out whole inscriptions with what they meant. Carried and studied, it lets its reader make out the old script.
